articles.title: macOS 27.3 Adds New Security Controls to Stop AI Apps From Accessing All Mac Data
articles.summary:
Apple has introduced new privacy controls in macOS 27.3 beta 2 that make it harder for apps, including AI assistants, to gain broad access to Mac data without clear user approval. Announced on November 16, 2026, the changes add narrower permissions, stronger warnings, and more visibility into app activity. The update follows Apple’s earlier warning […]

articles.title: Hackers Exploit Exposed AI Vendor Key to Breach 10 Barracuda Cloud Accounts in 44 Hours
articles.summary:
Hackers used a cloud access key exposed through an unnamed AI vendor to enter Barracuda’s cloud environment and reach about 10 accounts in roughly 44 hours. The November 1–2 intrusion crossed cloud services, data analytics, source code, and Kubernetes systems as the attacker collected credentials to keep moving.
